ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Act on Reporting and Use of Certain Financial Transaction Information (Act No. 15894, as amended), Act on Prevention of Money Laundering and Financing of Terrorism (Act No. 16313, as amended), Commercial Act of Korea (Act No. 17937, as amended) Articles 111, 341 and 466-2, and the FSC Regulation on Financial Company Due Diligence; enforcement guidance is issued by the Korean Financial Intelligence Unit (KoFIU) under the Financial Services Commission.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation (Certificate of Registered Matters / 등기사항증명서)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Court Registry Office, Supreme Court of Korea
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Step 1: Korean notary public notarization of the original and certified English translation. Step 2: If the destination state is a Hague Apostille Convention member: obtain an Apostille from the Korean Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA). If the destination state is NOT an Apostille member: submit the document to the Korean Embassy or Consulate for consular legalization. The two paths are mutually exclusive and must never be chained sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (Certificate of No Cancellation / Business Registration Certificate)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Korean National Tax Service and Court Registry Office
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Step 1: Korean notary public attestation of the business registration certificate and English translation. Step 2: Apostille by Korean MOFA for Hague member states; otherwise consular legalization by the Korean Embassy/Consulate in the destination country. Parallel paths only; sequential chaining of Apostille and consular legalization is prohibited.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution or Power of Attorney for Incorporation and Bank Account Opening
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Step 1: Execution in front of a Korean notary public; Step 2: Apostille by Korean MOFA if the destination state is an Apostille member; Step 3: For non-member states, obtain consular legalization from the Korean Embassy/Consulate. Use one path only based on the destination country status.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association (정관) certified true copy
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Korean notary public in the intended jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarize the Articles of Association at a Korean notary public; then obtain an Apostille from MOFA if the receiving jurisdiction is an Apostille member; if not, proceed with consular legalization at the Korean Embassy/Consulate. Do not combine both authentication methods.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter from a licensed Korean bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: The bank countersigns the reference letter, then the signature is notarized by a Korean notary; thereafter obtain an MOFA Apostille for Hague member states or consular legalization for non-member states. The selected path is exclusive to the destination state and no hybrid chain is permitted.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All UBOs, directors, shareholders above 25%, and senior officers must be screened at onboarding and continuously against the Korean Financial Intelligence Unit designated lists, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, OFAC SDN and non-SDN sanctions lists, EU consolidated sanctions, and domestic Korean anti-money-laundering cautionary notices. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for any PEP, foreign PEP, family member or close associate; independent source of wealth and source of funds evidence must be obtained and retained. Automated screening alerts must be escalated within 24 hours and unresolved matches require transaction refusal. For the disposable dialysis hemofilter manufacturing sector, standard risk applies, but every Swift_LC and TT_Wire payment must be monitored for trade-based money laundering indicators, invoice over/under-invoicing, and abnormal freight or consignee patterns.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Supreme Court of Korea Electronic Registration System (iROS) at www.iros.go.kr, operated by the Court Administration Office, together with the Korean Ministry of Justice business name clearance and search portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory corporate name must be registered in Hangul with the mandatory suffix 유한회사 (Yuhan Hoesa). English names are transliterations and must follow the Revised Romanization of Korean when shown on apostilled certificates. The four-tier naming doctrine requires: (1) exact identical name search in the local registry; (2) phonetic homophone and sound-similar search; (3) trademark/well-known mark conflict check; and (4) prohibited-token screening with ministerial approval for any national, governmental, medical, financial, or university-related term. The Hangul name controls over any parallel English transliteration.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the registry rejects a proposed name, the applicant receives a written refusal stating the statutory reason. Within 60 days the applicant may file an administrative appeal (행정심판) with the Central Administrative Appeals Commission, or within 90 days file a judicial appeal in the competent administrative court. The written appeal must include the original refusal, a corrected alternative name, the registry search result, a trademark clearance certificate, and an explanation of compliance with the four-tier naming doctrine. If the conflict arises from a prior trademark, a trademark consent letter may be submitted. The applicant may simultaneously file a fresh name reservation, and if the incorporation application is already pending, may request an urgent court order to proceed with a corrected name.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For this disposable dialysis hemofilter manufacturing entity, a virtual office or commercial mailbox is materially impermissible as the statutory registered office. The National Tax Service requires a physical place of business for business registration and VAT filing; the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS) requires a physical manufacturing facility and quality-management system; and Korean banks reject virtual mailbox addresses during AML site-visit controls. A virtual address may be used only as a non-statutory liaison or marketing address after written approval, but not as the corporate seat for this industry.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: 65% likelihood of an unannounced physical inspection within the first 12 months of registration, escalating to 90% if the registered office is inconsistent with the stated production site. Trigger checklist: (1) municipal tax office post-registration confirmation visit; (2) MFDS pre-license GMP facility inspection; (3) registry judge verification visit; (4) bank credit and AML site visit before account activation; (5) National Pension and Employment Insurance field audit; (6) local fire and electrical safety inspection. Any discrepancy between the registered office and actual manufacturing location invites administrative closure and adverse AML review.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official court fee schedule under the Court Fees Act, applicable registration license tax and education surcharge for a limited liability company with no minimum capital

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of Articles of Association (정관 공증)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Korean notary public in the target jurisdiction
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notary Fee Act statutory tariff based on capital amount and number of pages

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified English translation of Articles of Association, Certificate of Incorporation, and supporting corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Accredited translation firm with sworn translator approval
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark per certified translation set used for apostille and bank onboarding

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and consular legalization processing for five-instrument documentary bundle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Korean Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) and Korean Embassy/Consulate in the destination state
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: MOFA official apostille fee plus consular legalization fee and authorized courier handling; only one authentication path is charged based on destination state membership

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO, PEP, OFAC, UN, and KoFIU screening compliance package
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Compliance counsel or FIU-registered external AML analyst
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market retainer for corporate UBO piercing and continuous sanctions screening for one entity

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Physical registered office initial one-year occupancy and substance documentation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Commercial lessor and municipal tax office deposit records
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a small-scale manufacturing coordinator office in the target Korean jurisdiction

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Act of the Republic of Korea (Act No. 1000, February 12, 1962, as most recently amended), Articles 543 to 584 governing Yuhan Hoesa (limited liability companies), in particular Articles 544, 546, 548, 550, 552, 555, 557, 560, 563, 566, 567, 578 and 583; Article 317 on application for incorporation registration; the Commercial Registration Rules of the Supreme Court; the Foreign Investment Promotion Act (Act No. 5559, as most recently amended), Articles 4, 5 and 6; and the Corporate Tax Act, Article 4, for entity-level taxation.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Commercial Registration Office of the District Court having jurisdiction over the registered office in the Republic of Korea; e-filing is accepted through the Supreme Court of Korea's IROS online registration system at www.iros.go.kr.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of Incorporation of a Limited Company (Yuhan Hoesa) on the court-prescribed form under the Commercial Registration Rules, accompanied by the notarized Articles of Incorporation and all required annexes.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is imposed for a Yuhan Hoesa. The initial stated capital is fixed freely in the Articles of Incorporation, but every share subscription must be fully paid in cash or lawful in-kind contribution before registration. There is no blocked escrow account required for domestic founders; however, a foreign investor must remit capital from abroad through a designated foreign exchange bank, file a foreign investment report under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act, and ensure the remitted funds are credited as capital investment in a Korean bank account to be evidenced by a subscription-price deposit certificate or foreign investment registration documentation before incorporation registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF YUHAN HOESA. WHEREAS, the incorporators have duly adopted and caused to be notarized the Articles of Incorporation of Yuhan Hoesa, a limited liability company organized under the Commercial Act of the Republic of Korea; and WHEREAS, all issued shares have been subscribed in full and the aggregate subscription price has been paid or contributed as required by Articles 546 and 548 of the Commercial Act; and WHEREAS, before the statutory application for incorporation registration is submitted to the competent District Court, the Company must approve its capital structure, banking mandate, registered office, and initial statutory officers; NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED as follows: 1. Capital Subscription and Ratification. The statement of capital, number of shares, nominal value per share, and share subscription list contained in the Articles of Incorporation are hereby ratified and confirmed. The Chief Executive Officer is directed to maintain the shareholders' register, issue share certificates, and ensure that no share is issued at a discount or otherwise in violation of the Commercial Act. 2. Banking Authorization. The domestic bank accounts specified in the bank mandate annexed to these minutes are approved as corporate accounts. The Chief Executive Officer, the Chief Financial Officer, and any two officers acting jointly, or such other applicable signatory combination set forth in the bank mandate, are authorized to open, maintain, operate, close, and sign for such accounts, to deposit and withdraw funds, to issue and endorse checks and payment instructions, to negotiate or accept bills, and to execute SWIFT letters of credit and telegraphic transfer instructions on behalf of the Company. 3. Registered Office Adoption. The address of the registered office stated in the Articles of Incorporation is adopted as the Company's registered address and statutory seat for all legal and administrative purposes. The officers are directed to file the registration with the competent Commercial Registration Office, to display the corporate nameplate and maintain the corporate seal at that address, and to preserve all statutory books and registers there. 4. Appointment of Statutory Officers. The following persons are elected and appointed to the offices set opposite their names, each having consented to serve and being legally qualified: [Name] as Chief Executive Officer and Representative Director; [Name] as Director and Chief Financial Officer; [Name] as Director; and [Name] as Statutory Auditor or Compliance Officer. Each officer shall have the powers and duties set out in the Articles of Incorporation and the Commercial Act and shall be entitled to the compensation described in the officer consent forms. 5. General Implementation Authorization. Any officer, employee, or authorized agent of the Company is authorized, acting individually or jointly where required, to execute, notarize, file, verify, submit, pay fees for, and deliver all documents, certificates, applications, and instruments necessary or convenient to carry out these resolutions, including court incorporation filings, tax registrations, business registrations, foreign investment registrations, and permits required by the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, environmental authorities, fire authorities, and occupational safety regulators. 6. Severability and Validity. If any provision of these resolutions is held invalid, illegal, or unenforceable, the remaining provisions shall continue in full force and effect. These resolutions may be produced to any governmental authority, bank, or third party as conclusive evidence of the authority conferred. Adopted unanimously by the first board of directors on [Date] by resolution, with the meeting duly convened and the quorum present.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Reservation and Registered Office Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Supreme Court of Korea Commercial Registration Information Center (IROS) online portal at www.iros.go.kr; local District Court Registry office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Search the IROS company registry to confirm that the proposed name Yuhan Hoesa is available and does not coincide with or resemble any registered company name in the Republic of Korea for the same or similar business purpose. Submit a name-reservation application in Korean using the prescribed IROS form, specify the legal form as Yuhan Hoesa, select the business purpose code corresponding to manufacturing of medical and dental instruments and supplies (ISIC 3250 / NAICS 339112 equivalent), enter the intended registered office address, and pay the statutory e-filing fee. IROS will issue a name-reservation confirmation notice valid for six months. If the investor is a foreign person or foreign company, also prepare the foreign investment report number or a written statement of planned foreign investment for use in subsequent submission steps.
required_dossiers: Standard IROS application for company name reservation
Certified copy of passport or corporate registration certificate of each incorporator
Written power of attorney if filed through a licensed agent
Statement of business purpose and ISIC/NAICS classification code
Intended registered office address in Korea
Foreign investment report number, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused because of similarity to an existing company name, file an immediate alternative name-reservation application or submit the written consent of the holder of the similar name; if the IROS filing is suspended for incomplete information, cure by uploading the missing identification document within the statutory correction period and re-submitting; an administrative appeal may be made to the relevant registration officer within seven days of the refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation, Execution, and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public under the Notary Act of the Republic of Korea; Korean Notary Association; notarial office having jurisdiction over the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Articles of Incorporation in the Korean language containing all mandatory provisions under Commercial Act Article 544, including the legal form as Yuhan Hoesa, corporate name, business objects covering the manufacture, processing, import, export, and sale of disposable dialysis hemodialyzers and other medical devices, registered office address, total share capital, par value and number of shares issued, method of public notice, and the names and subscriptions of the incorporators. All incorporators, or their duly qualified attorneys-in-fact, must personally appear before a notary public, verify identity, sign and seal the articles, and receive notarial certification. If any subscriber contributes assets in kind, a court-appointed inspector's report or a valid exemption under the Commercial Act must be annexed. The notary reviews the legality of the articles, attaches the notarial certificate, and returns the original executed copy for use in court registration.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Incorporation in Korean
Certified true copies of identification documents for all incorporators
Passport copies and corporate registration abstracts for foreign corporate shareholders
Power of attorney if signed by proxy
In-kind contribution valuation report and court inspector certificate, if applicable
Share subscription list showing the number of shares subscribed by each incorporator
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary refuses to certify because the articles omit a mandatory provision, promptly amend the articles and re-submit; if a court inspector is required for an in-kind contribution, file a petition with the District Court and obtain a supplemental report, which will add an estimated seven days; if the notary questions business purpose legality, narrow or reformulate the business objects in accordance with the Medical Devices Act and the Commercial Act and re-notarize.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of Subscription Price and Foreign Investment Capital Deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Designated Foreign Exchange Bank under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act (for foreign subscribers); any commercial bank in Korea holding the subscription-price deposit for domestic subscribers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary corporate or subscription deposit account in the name of Yuhan Hoesa or the subscription agent as accepted by bank practice. Each subscriber must pay in full the Korean won equivalent of the subscription price in accordance with the terms set in the Articles of Incorporation. The bank will issue a certificate of deposit of subscription price, or an equivalent paid-in-capital certificate, reflecting the exact amount credited and identifying the depositor and the company. For a foreign capital contribution, the money must be remitted from abroad under a foreign investment report under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act, and the wiring instructions must clearly state that the remittance is a capital investment for incorporation of Yuhan Hoesa and not a trade settlement or loan. The bank will code the credit as foreign direct investment and will not permit withdrawal until the company obtains its certificate of incorporation and the finalized banking mandate is approved. Obtain two treaty original copies of the deposit certificate from the bank for submission to the District Court and the National Tax Service.
required_dossiers: Notarized or draft Articles of Incorporation
Foreign investment report receipt if any subscriber is a foreign person or company
SWIFT remittance instruction from the remitting bank
Passport or corporate certificate of each subscriber
Bank account application and corporate name reservation certificate
Internal bank mandate or initial board resolution authorizing account opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the deposit ticket because the funds appear to be a loan or an ordinary remittance, submit the foreign investment report number and a legal opinion under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act and request the bank to reclassify the amount as capital investment; if the bank imposes additional anti-money-laundering review, provide the source-of-funds declaration and beneficial ownership disclosure; if the remittance is delayed beyond the estimated SLA, extend the schedule and obtain a foreign currency purchase/sale confirmation from the bank.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Statutory Officer Appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Initial board of directors and incorporators as an internal corporate body; the resulting resolution and officer consents are subsequently filed with the Commercial Registration Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting in compliance with Commercial Act Article 583 and the company's articles. Distribute the meeting notice and agenda, or obtain signed waiver of notice from every initial director, and record the minutes containing the pro-forma board resolution. The board must ratify the share subscriptions and paid-in capital, approve the corporate banking authorization and signatory mandate, adopt the registered office address, and appoint the Chief Executive Officer, representative director, Chief Financial Officer, additional directors if any, and statutory auditor or compliance officer if required or voluntarily established. Each appointed officer must sign a formal consent to serve, submit national or foreign identification, and provide a seal specimen or signature specimen. The minutes must be signed by the chairperson and secretary, or by the unanimous written consent of all directors, and must be included in the commercial registration annex. The resolution text should mirror the pro-forma resolution contained in the corporate governance record of the company.
required_dossiers: Notice of the first board meeting or written waiver of notice
First board resolution text
National or foreign identification and address proof of each officer
Consent to office forms and signature/seal specimens
Name reservation confirmation certificate
Bank certificate of deposit for paid-in capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an appointee is disqualified under Commercial Act Article 566 or is otherwise unable to serve, convene a replacement board meeting and adopt a substitute resolution; if the resolution is challenged for lack of quorum, obtain a unanimous written consent signed by all directors or re-notice and reconvene; any clerical defect in the minutes may be cured by amendatory board resolution and court filing before the registration application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registration of Incorporation with the District Court
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registration Office of the District Court with jurisdiction over the registered office; electronic filing through the IROS e-registration system
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within three weeks of the notarization of the Articles of Incorporation, file the application for registration of incorporation of the Yuhan Hoesa on the official form prescribed by the Commercial Registration Rules. Attach the notarized articles, the certificate of deposit of subscription price, the share subscription list, the first board resolution, officer consent and seal specimens, and the name reservation confirmation. Pay the registration license tax, education surtax, and court registration fee. The registration officer examines compliance with the Commercial Act, statutory officers, capital deposit, and registered office, and if all requirements are satisfied, registers the company and issues the certified corporate registry extract and certificate of incorporation. Under Commercial Act Article 317, the company acquires legal personality only upon this registration.
required_dossiers: Court-prescribed application for incorporation registration
Notarized Articles of Incorporation
Certificate of deposit of subscription price
Share subscription list
First board resolution with officer consent and seal specimens
Name reservation confirmation certificate
Power of attorney and court fee payment receipts
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registration officer issues a correction notice or supplementary order, answer within the specified period, usually seven days, by filing the missing annex or amending the articles; if the application is rejected, apply for a correction order or administrative appeal within fourteen days; if the three-week statutory deadline is missed, re-execute and re-notarize the articles and obtain a fresh name reservation and deposit certificate before re-filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: District Tax Office of the National Tax Service (NTS); KOTRA Invest Korea; designated foreign exchange bank for foreign-invested company registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within thirty days of the district court registration, submit the business registration application to the district tax office having jurisdiction over the registered office and the place of business, if the place of business is already determined. Enclose the certified corporate registry extract, certificate of incorporation, notarized articles, lease agreement or ownership document for the registered office, and identification of the representative director. The tax office will issue the corporate business registration certificate with the corporate tax and value-added tax registration numbers. If foreign shareholders or foreign investment is present, file the registration of a foreign-invested company under Article 6 of the Foreign Investment Promotion Act with KOTRA or the designated foreign exchange bank and obtain the foreign-invested company registration certificate. Also open the official corporate bank account and register the corporate seal certificate with the bank in accordance with the approved banking mandate.
required_dossiers: Business registration application form on the NTS standard format
Certified corporate registry extract
Certificate of incorporation
Lease agreement or ownership certificate for the registered office
Notarized Articles of Incorporation
Foreign investment report number and foreign-invested company registration form, if applicable
Identification of the representative director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax office queries the place of business because of a mismatch between the registered office and actual factory site, submit the lease contract, building register abstract, and municipal factory establishment approval; if the foreign-invested company registration is delayed, obtain a certificate from KOTRA confirming timely filing; if a late-filing penalty is threatened, present proof of submission within the thirty-day period and apply for a discretionary waiver under national tax procedure.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS), Medical Device Safety Bureau; local municipal City/Gun/Gu building and factory authorities; Korea Occupational Safety and Health Agency (KOSHA); National Fire Agency and local fire station with jurisdiction over the factory site
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Medical Device Manufacturing Business License and Medical Device GMP Certification under Articles 6 and 12 of the Medical Devices Act; Medical Device Item (Product) Approval for the Disposable Dialysis Hemofilter under Article 10; factory establishment and completion approval under the Building Act and the Industrial Cluster Development and Factory Establishment Act

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment of the Republic of Korea and the competent Regional Environmental Office; municipal government for prior environmental screening of small factory establishments
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: For a hollow-fiber polyethersulfone dialyzer manufacturing plant using extrusion, potting, sterilization, and wastewater discharge, the mandatory threshold is likely an environmental installation report for air-pollutant emission facilities under the Clean Air Conservation Act and a wastewater discharge facility report under the Water Environment Conservation Act. A full Environmental Impact Assessment under the Environmental Impact Assessment Act is required only for large-scale industrial development projects or industrial complexes above the statutory scale; for an individual medical device factory, the usual tier is a 'prior environmental screening' or 'facility installation report', not a full EIA, unless the site is located in an environmentally sensitive zone or the factory area is exceptionally large.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Process wastewater must meet the Korean industrial effluent standards, generally not exceeding BOD 30 mg/L, COD 40 mg/L, TSS 30 mg/L, total nitrogen 60 mg/L, and total phosphorus 8 mg/L for facilities with daily discharge above 50 m3, and stricter standards apply in watershed protection zones. Air emissions from polymer extrusion and solvent use must maintain total volatile organic compounds below 50 ppm at the stack and particulate matter below 30 mg/m3. If ethylene oxide or other gaseous sterilants are used, the 8-hour time-weighted average occupational exposure limit for EtO shall not exceed 1 ppm, and the sterilization exhaust must be treated by an acid scrubber or catalytic oxidizer achieving not less than 95% destruction or removal efficiency. Hazardous waste generated by the dialysis membrane process must be characterized, packaged, and transported exclusively to licensed hazardous waste treatment facilities in accordance with the Wastes Control Act.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The manufacturing facility must obtain a Fire Safety Completion Inspection Certificate under the Fire Service Act from the local fire department, including approved fire alarm and suppression systems, emergency lighting, exit signage, evacuation routes, fire hydrants, and fire extinguishers. A certified fire protection system inspection and annual fire safety maintenance must be documented. Civil Defense emergency evacuation planning under the Framework Act on Civil Defense is required for any factory facility. The facility must also obtain occupational safety clearance from the Ministry of Employment and Labor, including a Process Safety Management plan if hazardous chemicals are stored or used above the statutory thresholds, and a workplace environment measurement report covering chemical agents such as N-methyl-2-pyrrolidone, polyvinylpyrrolidone, isopropyl alcohol, and ethylene oxide. Structural load inspections by a licensed architect or engineer are required for the cleanroom, HVAC systems, pure water generation equipment, compressed air systems, and sterilizer installations to verify that the building can support the physical manufacturing infrastructure.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: National Tax Service (NTS) of the Republic of Korea; online national electronic portal is HomeTax (Hometax) at www.hometax.go.kr for business registration, electronic tax invoice filing, and VAT returns; Korea Customs Service UNI-PASS portal (unipass.customs.go.kr) is the separate authoritative electronic customs clearance platform for export declarations and trade statistics.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For the intended Korean entity structure Yuhan Hoesa LLC, the LLC is a Korean-resident domestic corporation that must first be incorporated under the Korean Commercial Act and registered with the competent registry court, resulting in the official certificate of incorporation registration evidence. Next, the company must open a corporate bank account with a licensed Korean foreign exchange bank. The company then files a Business Registration Application with the district tax office having jurisdiction over its principal place of business within the statutory registration window after business commencement, attaching the certificate of incorporation registration, the articles of incorporation, the corporate lease contract, the corporate seal certificate, a board resolution or power of attorney appointing the tax representative, passports or equivalent identity documents of foreign officers and shareholders, and the foreign investment declaration if the Foreign Investment Promotion Act applies. Upon acceptance, the National Tax Service issues the unified 10-digit Business Registration Number, which simultaneously serves as the corporate income tax TIN, the VAT registration identifier, and the electronic tax invoice identification number. A Yuhan Hoesa LLC that manufactures Class II or Class III medical devices, including dialysis hemofilters, must also hold a Medical Device Manufacturing License issued by the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety before commercial manufacture and export; the license number is recorded in customs export submissions. If the foreign non-resident entity has no Korean domestic place of business and operates without forming a Korean LLC, the non-resident entity must appoint a tax representative recognized by the NTS and may complete a simplified non-resident VAT registration through HomeTax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. Korean tax law does not offer a check-the-box pass-through election for a Yuhan Hoesa LLC; the domestic corporation is automatically taxed at entity level under the Corporate Income Tax Act, and no hybrid mismatch entity classification election is available. The only related statutory grouping tool is the narrow Korean consolidated corporate tax group regime, which does not alter entity-level taxation and is not an elective pass-through mechanism.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value-Added Tax Act and its Enforcement Decree
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: None - no turnover-based VAT registration threshold applies in Korea. Every entity engaged in business, including a dialysis hemofilter manufacturer such as Yuhan Hoesa LLC, must register with the NTS at or near the commencement of operations. The KRW 80,000,000 annual revenue figure merely determines eligibility for simplified taxable person treatment, and that simplified regime is not available to a corporate manufacturer; the Yuhan Hoesa LLC is therefore mandatorily a general taxable person, which enables full input VAT deduction and claims for the 0% export VAT rate.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Korean law mandates electronic tax invoice issuance for B2B supplies. A general taxable person must transmit each electronic tax invoice through the NTS HomeTax platform or through an NTS-certified ERP/API connector no later than the day following the invoice issuance date. The NTS performs real-time validation, risk scoring, digital signature verification, and digital stamping of each electronic tax invoice with a unique receipt number. For zero-rated exports, the electronic tax invoice is issued with the zero-rated supply code and is automatically cross-matched against the Korea Customs Service export declaration transmitted through UNI-PASS. There is no physical fiscal stamping requirement; anti-fraud compliance is achieved through mandatory real-time electronic transmission, unique document identification, cryptographic integrity controls, and NTS reconciliation with customs and foreign exchange data.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under Article 11 of the Value-Added Tax Act, exported goods, including disposable dialysis hemofilters manufactured in Korea, are subject to VAT at the 0% rate when the goods are physically shipped from Korea to a foreign destination, ownership passes to the foreign buyer, and the export declaration has been duly accepted by Korea Customs Service. The exporter must retain evidence of the actual export and of the receipt of the export price in foreign currency through the Korean foreign exchange banking system. Qualifying offshore digital services are also zero-rated if supplied to a non-resident consumer or foreign user and delivered or performed outside Korea as set out in the Enforcement Decree. Incidental services directly connected with the exported goods, such as international freight and export handling, may also qualify under the statutory export service zero-rating rules.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Korea Customs Service Export Declaration (Export Declaration Certificate) filed and accepted through the UNI-PASS electronic clearance system

Bill of Lading (ocean bill of lading or air waybill) evidencing physical departure, the exporter as shipper, the foreign buyer as consignee, and the dialysis hemofilter goods with corresponding details
Commercial Invoice and Packing List in original form matching the customs export declaration and shipment records

Foreign Exchange Settlement Confirmation / Export Proceeds Receipt issued by a licensed Korean foreign exchange bank, which is the functional equivalent of an Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC), proving receipt of the foreign currency export proceeds from the foreign counterparty
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The National Tax Service conducts post-export verification by cross-matching UNI-PASS export declarations, cargo departure and vessel/aircraft movement data, electronic tax invoices coded as zero-rated supplies, and the exporter's foreign exchange receipt records obtained through the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act banking information. If the exporter fails to substantiate actual physical export or fails to receive the export proceeds in foreign currency within 180 days without an approved NTS or customs extension, the NTS will reassess the supply at the standard 10% VAT, disallow the corresponding input VAT deduction, and claw back any VAT refund previously paid. The taxpayer will also be liable for statutory additional tax, including up to 40% for fraudulent underreporting and 20% for unfaithful underreporting, together with statutory interest for overdue tax. If zero-rating documentation is false or forged, the case may be referred for criminal prosecution under the Punishment of Tax Evaders Act, Korea Customs Service may impose penalties and suspend export privileges under the Customs Act, and the foreign exchange bank may report violations under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bank of Korea (BOK), with resident inspection power delegated from the Ministry of Economy and Finance (MOEF) under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act; policy and licensing authority is shared with the Financial Services Commission (FSC) and the Bank of Korea is the statutory manager of South Korea's foreign exchange reserves, clearing settlement systems, and KRW liquidity conditions for designated foreign exchange banks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: South Korea operates a largely liberalized capital and current account system, yet all cross-border payments and foreign exchange transactions remain subject to a post-transaction reporting and declaration framework under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act. Current account operations, including ordinary trade payments, dividends, and service fees, are convertible without quantitative restriction provided the beneficiary is identified, the underlying transaction is genuine, and the correct foreign exchange purpose code is reported through an authorized foreign exchange bank. Capital account transactions, however, require pre-notification or ex-post reporting depending on the type: direct foreign investment into an entity, inbound loans, and equity purchases by non-residents must be cleared through the Foreign Investment Promotion Act and reported to KOTRA/MOEF; securities investment above certain thresholds must pass through the registry on the Foreign Exchange Information Network (FEIN). For a non-resident-owned Yuhan Hoesa, the principal hurdle is demonstrating that the initial equity capital or shareholder loan is actually inbound investment, not a domestic deposit or re-credited offshore funds, and that all subsequent profit remittances are settled after full corporate tax and local surtax obligations are discharged. There are no formal mandatory surrender or conversion ratio requirements for export receipts in ordinary circumstances; foreign currency earned in exports may be held in onshore foreign currency bank accounts or converted to KRW at the exporter's discretion, but the underlying claim must be collected within the statutory settlement period and the resulting foreign currency position must be reported. Practical convertibility is high for trade-backed operations, but banks will enforce beneficial-ownership disclosure and exact-wire-purpose integrity to avoid disguised capital flows or tax arbitrage. The Bank of Korea can, in a stress scenario or severe capital flow reversal, reinstate surrender-like measures under emergency decrees, so a compliant treasury must maintain audit-ready trade documentation for every transaction.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act and delegated regulations of MOEF, export proceeds must be collected through an authorized foreign exchange bank within 90 calendar days from the date of the export declaration (shipment), unless an extension is approved for designated commodity categories, overdue accounts, or delayed collection from non-Puro jurisdictions. There is no fixed statutory mandatory conversion ratio into KRW; the exporter may maintain the foreign currency exposure in an export proceeds account or convert at prevailing market rates. However, the full amount must be evidenced by the exchange bank's receipt confirmation and matched against the electronic customs document in the Korea Customs Service EDI system. Withholding taxes, transfer pricing adjustments, and discounting of long-term receivables may require prior approval or declaration to the tax authority before the repatriation surplus can be distributed or netted.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (Demand Foreign Currency) for foreign investment verification, plus a basic KRW operational settlement account
Foreign Currency Capital Deposit Account and paired KRW Business Checking Account for trade settlements
SEF (Security Export/Import) Trade Settlement Account and KRW operating account with separate HKD/USD sub-accounts
Escrow-like shelter account for inbound equity capital and a KRW general transaction account covered by the Korea Trade Insurance Corporation, if LC and receivable financing are needed

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore fintech EMI providers (e.g., digital-only banks or multi-currency e-money wallets) are not viable as a primary settlement rail for this Korean LLC. Korean law defines electronic money institutions and foreign EMIs cannot provide KRW-denominated deposit accounts or execute local wire transfers under the Banking Act unless licensed by the FSS as a domestic bank or registered broker with a physical local branch under the Electronic Financial Transactions Act. Tier-1 Korean banks may refuse to clear payments for an unlicensed EMI because the end beneficiary KYC cannot satisfy the Act on Reporting and Use of Certain Financial Information. The only permissible use of a fintech gateway would be as a pre-account message/aggregation layer for invoicing data, provided the actual funds remain inside the local FX bank's correspondent channel. Therefore, a physical banking relationship with a Tier-1 commercial bank is mandatory, and any foreign EMI such as Wise or Revolut Business cannot legally maintain the company's KRW liquidity or satisfy capital verification.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Statutory directors and ultimate beneficial owners are required to appear in-person at a designated branch of the Korean bank for first-class KYC, and this is not automatically waivable for foreign residents. The bank's compliance committee will normally require the director, the ultimate beneficial owner, and the authorized signatory to attend a live identification interview at the domestic branch where the account is opened. In exceptional cases, a notarized power of attorney validated through a Korean consulate overseas may be accepted for secondary signatory appointment, but the primary director or a senior managing member must still pass a physical interview at either the local branch or, if the bank maintains an overseas branch with global banking mandate, through a video-interview supplemented by apostilled corporate evidence. A pure remote consular proxy opening is strongly discouraged because the bank will request a physical certificate-of-existence letter and legalized entity documents from the Korean court or registry office, and any mismatch between the beneficial ownership in the corporate resolution and the internal list of exempted medical device exporters will trigger prolonged AML review. To accelerate onboarding, all members should be dual-role administrators in the incorporation deed, with corporate seals and apostille certifications prepared before any branch interview is booked.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The company is a thinly capitalized LLC with 100% non-resident ownership and no local prior financial footprint; the bank's screening system may flag as a potential shell or pass-through conduit.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A full corporate ownership stack from the Registry of Companies showing both the issued and paid-in share register, beneficial ownership declarations and UBO certificates for each natural person, a notarized business plan demonstrating factory premises and leasing contracts, a verified proof of physical office in Korea or an undertaking to resolve the office address before first draw, and audited financial statements of the parent or investor committing to a defined paid-in capital schedule with the source of funds clearly documented.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial capital injection arrives as a large wire from an offshore personal account or from a jurisdiction that is not a recognized financial intelligence unit member, creating difficult-to-verify source of wealth.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A due diligence package containing the investor's bank references and corresponding 3-month bank statements from a regulated financial institution, signed and notarized declaration of source of wealth (salary, dividends, lawful crypto realization, or prior company sale), share subscription agreement, SWIFT confirmation of the inbound transfer with a explicit foreign investment purpose code, and a tax-residence certificate of each investor to demonstrate that no undisclosed third-party beneficial owner is behind the transaction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade flows show unusually long payment settlements (90 days) for dialysis membrane raw materials, and the first year's import/export amounts may be materially inconsistent with the stated minimum capital, triggering counterparty red flags for medical devices.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Drill-down evidence: 12-month purchase orders from the same suppliers, BoL/AWB and customs declarations from West and Southeast Asia, a statement of outstanding AP/AR with aging, a transfer-pricing master file establishing arm's-length margins for polyethersulfone membrane and cannula sets, and letters of credit issued by regional banks in favor of the supplier, plus the business license and ISO 13485 certificate for the Korean manufacturing unit.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The bank compliance committee may receive a sanctions indication on the trade finance message because the dialysis concentrate or hollow fiber membranes are consigned to a country with restrictive export controls, or because the end user hospital is on an anti-corruption discrepancy list.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A comprehensive end-user statement and end-use certificate from the hospital procurement office, a complete mounted product code unpacking under ISIC 3250 and US HS 3920/3921 subheadings confirming the product is not on any dual-use annex, an attested export control classification from the Korea Strategic Trade Institute, and a post-shipment monitoring commitment letter from the exporter to provide the bank with the final customs clearance confirmation within 10 business days of delivery.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The prevailing compliant route for the initial capital injection is as follows: 1) File a foreign investment report under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act with KOTRA or authorized county offices; 2) procure the Foreign Exchange Notification (Investment Registration) and apply for a foreign currency certificate; 3) obtain from a selected Tier-1 bank preliminary service agreement for a

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax and Local Income Tax Surtax Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Tax Service (NTS) for national corporate tax; local government (Si/Gun/Gu) for the local income tax surtax
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a December 31 fiscal year end, the final corporate tax return is due by March 31 of the following year; for a non-calendar fiscal year, the return is due within three months after fiscal year end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers additional tax of 10% of the unpaid tax; underreported taxable income triggers an additional tax of 20%; tax evasion/concealment triggers an additional tax of 40%; overdue national tax accrues 0.025% daily interest (about 0.66% monthly). Habitual non-filing after repeated NTS demands can result in asset seizure, freezing of corporate bank accounts, cancellation of the business registration, and criminal referral under the Tax Evasion Punishment Act; administrative strike-off of the entity is not a standard Korean procedure, but prolonged non-compliance can support involuntary dissolution proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Tax Service (NTS) through the Home Tax Service electronic filing system
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: First half-period (January 1 to June 30) return and payment due July 25 of the same year; second half-period (July 1 to December 31) return and payment due January 25 of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing imposes an additional tax of 10% of the unpaid VAT; underreporting false returns impose 10% or 20% additional tax; late payment interest accrues at 0.025% per day. Continuous failure to file can lead to tax collection seizure, suspension or cancellation of business registration, and criminal prosecution for VAT evasion.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Statutory External Audit Report and Audited Financial Statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Financial Supervisory Service (FSS) via the DART system; audit report also filed with the Korean Institute of Certified Public Accountants (KICPA) when mandated by the Act on External Audit of Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: The annual general meeting of members/directors approving audited financial statements must be held within three months after fiscal year end (March 31 for a December 31 year end); the external audit report and audited financial statements must be submitted to the FSS/DART within 15 days after the auditors report or before the corporate tax return deadline, whichever first applies.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to appoint or file the mandatory independent CPA audit report allows the FSS to impose administrative fines up to KRW 20,000,000 under the Act on External Audit of Companies, designate the company for enhanced monitoring, restrict use of statutory incentives, and, if combined with unresolved registry or tax violations, expose the company to involuntary dissolution proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign-Invested Enterprise Annual Status Report and Beneficial Ownership Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy (MOTIE) through KOTRA or the designated foreign investment reception center; Financial Supervisory Service receives related disclosures when applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a December 31 fiscal year end, the annual foreign-invested enterprise status report is due by March 31 of the following year; any transfer of foreign-invested membership interests or change in ultimate beneficial ownership must be reported within 30 days of the triggering event.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing, late filing, or false filing of the foreign-invested enterprise status information is subject to fines, corrective orders, and loss of foreign investment protection under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act; removal of foreign investment registration can cancel tax preferences and block dividend and capital repatriation, with continued non-compliance escalating to administrative dissolution action.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Employer Withholding Tax Final Settlement for Employees
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Monthly wage and salary income taxes withheld by the employer are due by the 10th day of the following month; the annual financial settlement of wage withholding for the preceding tax year is due by March 10 of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to withhold or remit employee wage tax triggers employer personal withholding liability, additional tax of 10% for unauthorized failure to withhold, daily overdue interest of 0.025%, and criminal referral for fraudulent non-remittance; persistent default can lead to seizure of corporate assets and business registration cancellation.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under the Act on External Audit of Companies, mandatory independent CPA audit applies where the company is listed on a Korean exchange, or where total assets as of the immediately preceding fiscal year end equal or exceed KRW 12,000,000,000 (about USD 9.2 million at KRW 1,300 per USD); also mandatory where total assets are at least KRW 7,000,000,000 and the company employs at least 1,000 persons, and for any company designated by Presidential Decree or special statutes as requiring audited financial statements. There is no general turnover-only trigger, but annual turnover and headcount are considered materiality inputs when the asset/headcount thresholds are met.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Korean International Financial Reporting Standards (K-IFRS) apply to all companies subject to mandatory external audit; non-public Yuhan Hoesa entities that do not cross the audit threshold may elect K-GAAP (Korean Generally Accepted Accounting Principles) as prescribed by the Korean Institute of Certified Public Accountants and the Financial Supervisory Service, but must use K-IFRS if mandatory audit is triggered.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Yuhan Hoesa must at all times maintain a current register of members/quotaholders and beneficial ownership records. Any transfer of membership interests, change of directors, or change of ultimate beneficial ownership must be registered with the Commercial Registry Court within two weeks, and if foreign investment is involved, reported to KOTRA/Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy within 30 days. The company must also perform an annual beneficial ownership confirmation as part of the foreign-invested enterprise status report due by March 31 (December fiscal year end); failing to keep these registers current leads to administrative fines and downgrade or termination of foreign-invested enterprise status.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Statutory Auditors or Audit Committee members (where appointed or mandatory)
Minute Book for members/shareholders and directors/managers meetings
Business books and accounting voucher ledger

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,200 - USD 4,500 per annum for professional Korean registered-office and corporate secretarial/agent services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 10,000 - USD 35,000 per annum for a certified CPA audit of a manufacturing subsidiary with inventories and cross-border/IFRS matters

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 24% top marginal rate (9% on taxable income up to KRW 200 million; 19% on KRW 200 million to KRW 20 billion; 21% on KRW 20 billion to KRW 300 billion; 24% above KRW 300 billion) plus 10% local income tax surcharge resulting in a combined top effective rate of 26.4%
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Restriction of Special Taxation Act: R&D tax credit up to 20% of qualifying research and development expenditure for medical device manufacturers; Free Economic Zone enterprises may enjoy a 50% corporate tax reduction for the first three years and a 25% reduction for the following two years subject to minimum substance thresholds; foreign-invested companies may receive tax holiday and customs duty exemptions under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act when investing in qualifying high-tech medical device projects; additional deductions available for employment creation and facility investment in Korean domestic manufacturing plants.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Tax Return (Corporate Tax Base and Tax Calculation Report) under Article 60 of the Corporate Tax Act; electronically filed through the National Tax Service Hometax portal at www.hometax.go.kr using the Corporate Tax Base and Tax Calculation Report form
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 3 months after the close of the fiscal year; for a December 31 fiscal year-end, the filing deadline is March 31 of the following year; interim semi-annual estimated payments are due within 2 months of the end of the first half of the taxable year and within 2 months of the second half

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate identification and head office location of Yuhan Hoesa; enter the Korean corporate registration number and the registered Korean factory address
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Korean LLC is a Korean tax resident; non-resident shareholders cannot substitute a foreign address. Foreign investment details must be reconciled with the Foreign Direct Investment registration certificate if treaty relief is later claimed on distributions. Failure to list the actual Korean manufacturing site will trigger a substance inquiry and immediate rejection of the return by the National Tax Service system.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal year period and applicable tax return signature declaration by the representative director
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The fiscal year must follow the Korean statutory calendar unless prior approval is obtained; a non-resident parent cannot compel a mismatched fiscal year for consolidation convenience. The director signing the return personally assumes responsibility for all statements; signing a false declaration converts a civil underreporting case into a criminal fraud case under the Punishment of Tax Evaders Act.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income determined under Korean GAAP after tax adjustments, including export income from manufacturing activities
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare worldwide income attributable to the Korean permanent establishment and all Korean-source income. For a dialysis hemofilter manufacturer, apportion profit to the Korean factory based on Core Income-Generating Activities: extrusion, potting, sterilization, and quality assurance. A non-resident parent cannot reallocate these profits to a low-tax jurisdiction through overselling commissions or off-invoicing without arm's-length documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax liability before credits after applying progressive tax brackets and loss carryforward
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply 9% to the first KRW 200 million, 19% to taxable income between KRW 200 million and KRW 20 billion, 21% between KRW 20 billion and KRW 300 billion, and 24% above KRW 300 billion. Loss carryforward claims must be supported by prior assessed tax returns; the Korean LLC may offset only its own losses, not losses of a foreign shareholder, and the carryforward period is limited to 5 years.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign tax credit and withholding reconciliation for payments to non-resident persons
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Korean manufacturing company cannot deduct dividends paid or distributable profits as an expense; instead, if remitting dividends, interest, or royalties to a non-resident shareholder, it must withhold 22% statutory tax (20% national corporate income tax plus 2% local income tax) and remit to the National Tax Service. To invoke treaty relief, the non-resident payee must provide a valid Tax Residency Certificate, beneficial ownership declaration, and complete Form A1-8 or the appropriate DTA reduction statement prior to payment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final tax payable, refund amount, and surcharge computation including late payment interest
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This box reconciles the total Korean corporate tax liability, interim payments, foreign tax credits, and withholding settle accounts. A shortfall creates personal secondary liability for the director. The Korean LLC must settle its Korean tax arrears before any profit repatriation; even a one-day delay generates daily delinquency interest of 0.025% and may expose the director to an international travel ban.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of 20% of the final tax payable if no valid return is filed; underreported tax penalty of 20% if the omission is negligent and 40% if fraudulent. Delinquency interest accrues at 0.025% per day and the Criminal Tax Evasion Law permits imprisonment up to 10 years and fines up to KRW 200 million for willful concealment. Representative directors of a nonresident-owned LLC may also be subject to travel restriction under Article 21 of the Framework Act on National Taxes when unpaid tax exceeds KRW 50 million.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 22% (20% corporate income tax under Article 98 of the Corporate Tax Act plus 2% local income tax surcharge) on gross dividends paid by a Korean LLC to a non-resident foreign shareholder, subject to reduction under an applicable bilateral income tax treaty
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim DTA relief, the non-resident shareholder must file a request for income tax exemption or reduction before the dividend remittance date with the National Tax Service, attaching: (1) a certified Tax Residency Certificate issued by the shareholder's home tax authority; (2) a beneficial ownership statement proving the shareholder is the final owner and is not a conduit; (3) documentary evidence of substantive economic activity with sufficient capital, staff, and operational risk in the residence jurisdiction; (4) a shareholding ownership certificate showing the number of voting shares to determine the applicable treaty dividend rate; and (5) the Korean LLC's withholding statement. Treaty benefits are denied if the beneficial owner fails the substance test or if the arrangement lacks valid commercial purposes.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding on royalties and interest paid to non-resident corporations is 22% (20% national plus 2% local income tax). Treaty rates vary by jurisdiction, for example 10% to 15% for royalties and 10% for interest under the Korea-US and Korea-Singapore treaties; all treaty claims require a Tax Residency Certificate, beneficial ownership substantiation, and active conduct criteria for royalty payments related to intangibles such as polyethersulfone membrane manufacturing technology.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: KRW 5 billion in aggregate annual cross-border related-party transactions triggers the mandatory Master File and Local File preparation; KRW 100 million in related-party transactions requires the annual international transactions disclosure schedule attached to the Korean corporate income tax return; a Country-by-Country Report is required when the consolidated group revenue exceeds KRW 200 billion.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: South Korea applies a substance-over-form principle under Article 17 of the Framework Act on National Taxes and the International Tax Adjustment Act. A Korean manufacturing LLC must perform Core Income-Generating Activities inside Korea: the physical extrusion, potting, sterilization, testing, and dispatch of disposable dialysis hemofilters. Passive holding structures, fake service invoices, or shell directorsindicate zero economic substance and allow the tax authority to recharacterize the entity as a conduit; treaty benefits and local incentives will be denied if CIGA are not located in Korea.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion through Transfer Pricing Misdeclaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The Korean LLC under-invoices exports of disposable dialysis hemofilters to a foreign related distributor in a zero-tax jurisdiction, while simultaneously booking deductible management fees to a related Cayman entity that has no employees or business premises; taxable income in Box 3 is artificially depressed by more than 30% or KRW 500 million; the intercompany pricing does not reflect a legitimate arm's length outcome and no contemporaneous local file is prepared.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Articles 47-2 and 47-3 of the Framework Act on National Taxes, fraudulent underreporting attracts an additional tax of 40% of the omitted corporate income tax plus 0.025% daily delinquency interest; the International Tax Adjustment Act permits recharacterization of the transaction and disallowance of the deductible payment; criminal penalties under the Punishment of Tax Evaders Act carry imprisonment up to 10 years and fines up to KRW 200 million.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for the underpaid corporate income tax, penalties, and delinquency interest; the National Tax Service may attach personal bank accounts and real estate under civil asset restitution statutes; the director may be blacklisted and subjected to an overseas travel ban if unpaid tax exceeds KRW 50 million; criminal conviction for deliberate tax evasion results in imprisonment of up to 10 years and disqualification from serving as a corporate director.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Yuhan Hoesa operates solely as an invoicing shell with no factory, production equipment, or employees; all dialysis hemofilter manufacturing is done by an unrelated third party in Southeast Asia while revenue is booked in Korea and then rapidly paid out as offshore royalties to a Singapore holding company controlled by the nonresident shareholder, with no management activity performed in Korea.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The National Tax Service may disregard the shell entity under Article 17 of the Framework Act on National Taxes and tax the beneficial owner directly; the Foreign Investment Promotion Act registration can be revoked because the investment lacks substantive operation; the International Tax Adjustment Act will deny the trademark or patent royalty deduction absent CIGA in Korea and levies a 20% understatement penalty plus withholding tax at 22%.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A director who signs financial statements for a sham entity commits actionable fraud and becomes personally liable for the full amount of corporate tax plus penalties; the director's assets are exposed to civil restitution claims; the Immigration Service enforces a travel ban and passport revocation while the National Tax Service blacklists the director for tax collection; criminal courts impose up to 5 years imprisonment for issuance of false documentation and abetting tax evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Medical Device Environmental and Export Licensing Violation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The Korean LLC exports dialysis hemofilters without FDA 510(k) clearance or CE marking by falsifying Korean medical device classification, and fails to comply with environmental permits for ethylene oxide sterilization emissions and disposal of polyethersulfone resin waste at its Korean plant; this creates a toxic tort and regulatory noncompliance that also contaminates financial disclosures made in the corporate tax return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Medical Devices Act and the Occupational Safety and Health Act, the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety imposes a penalty of up to KRW 100 million and orders plant closure for unapproved medical devices; the Clean Air Conservation Act and Waste Management Act provide fines up to KRW 200 million and imprisonment of the responsible plant director up to 7 years; Korean Customs Act false export declaration is punishable with up to 5 years imprisonment and a fine up to KRW 200 million, in addition to the 20% corporate tax penalty for tainted revenue.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The director and plant manager face personal criminal prosecution, up to 7 years imprisonment for environmental pollution, and separate civil restitution for contaminated land remediation costs; the export license and corporate registration may be revoked, and the director's name is placed on the Korea Customs Trade Blacklist with departure restriction; personal assets can be seized for unpaid environmental enforcement fines and remediation costs, and the director cannot obtain a new medical device manufacturing license for a period of 10 years.
